#!/bin/bash
# The checks of a branch the series was merged into: the tests of the
# package with the race detector, the tests through a shard, the config, and
# the linters with their three sets of tags. Untimed. Usage: check.sh <worktree> <out dir>
set -u
W=$1
O=$2
mkdir -p $O
cd $W || exit 2
date "+== %H:%M:%S package, -race" | tee $O/summary.txt
go test -race -count 1 -timeout 60m ./adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge/ > $O/pkg.log 2>&1
echo "package exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
date "+== %H:%M:%S through a shard" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
go test -tags integrationTest -race -count 1 -timeout 60m -run 'PostingEdge|Postingedge|postingedge' ./adapters/repos/db/ > $O/shard.log 2>&1
echo "shard exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
date "+== %H:%M:%S config and schema" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
go test -race -count 1 ./entities/vectorindex/... ./usecases/schema/ > $O/config.log 2>&1
echo "config exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
date "+== %H:%M:%S lint" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
~/go/bin/golangci-lint run ./adapters/repos/db/vector/... ./entities/vectorindex/... > $O/lint.log 2>&1
echo "lint exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
~/go/bin/golangci-lint run --build-tags postingedgebench ./adapters/repos/db/vector/... > $O/lint-bench.log 2>&1
echo "lint bench exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
~/go/bin/golangci-lint run --build-tags integrationTest ./adapters/repos/db/ > $O/lint-integration.log 2>&1
echo "lint integration exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
./tools/linter_go_routines.sh > $O/lint-goroutines.log 2>&1
echo "goroutines exit $?" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
date "+== %H:%M:%S done" | tee -a $O/summary.txt
